title: Across the Grey
description: Aldous says the Hearthspire's flame was put out on purpose, by the High Keeper. The answers are on Cindermoor, and only the Tidewright ferry goes there — if it runs again now the Gull's Beacon is lit.

stages.text: Ask Mara whether the Tidewright ferry will put in at Saltmarrow again.
Mara has hung the green lantern outside her door. Wait for the ferry's horn.
